items.title: Wayne Bergeron interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2020
items.q: the players I met on that band, one was named Brandon Fields... we got to be friends and it made me a better musician playing with them

ctx.x: A one hit wonder. Yeah. Exactly. It was actually a really cool band, and it’s kind of a pivotal point in my career because you know we all kind of looked back, well how did our careers start. And the players I met on that band, two players in particular, one was named Brandon Fields, who is one of the best saxophone players you will ever hear; and then a guy named Jeff Jorgensen, who is also the other great saxophone player you’ll ever hear, who is more unknown. But I’d never heard, I’d never played with any…

the trumpet player how to play, but they told me how to play. And I learned a lot from them, and some of my best gigs after that came from knowing those players. Because we got to be friends. And so that exposed me to even greater musicians that they were playing with you know. And so I got to hear all these different players and I grew as a player from that.
